newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz taps U.S. historian for Nazi book.
newsitem.headline: Allianz taps U.S. historian for Nazi book.

text.p: Germany's Allianz AG Holding on Friday said it had picked American historian Gerald Feldman to research the group's history, casting a critical eye on ties between Germany's largest insurer and the Nazi regime.

Allianz said Feldman, a professor of history and director of the centre for German and European Studies at the University of California at Berkley, will focus on the company's business during the late Weimar Republic and under the Nazi government.

The book, to be completed in about 18 months, will be the latest in a series commissioned by large German companies, including most prominently Deutsche Bank AG and Volkswagen AG, to expose their activities during the Third Reich.
"We want clarity about our corporate history and we will actively support this effort," Allianz management board chairman Henning Schulte-Noelle said in a statement.
The Munich-based group said all relevant information would be made public straight away.

Allianz's World War Two past has been at the centre of public attention since it was one of several insurers named in a multi-billion-dollar U.S. lawsuit that alleged Holocaust survivors were cheated of their assets.
